stories.title: Tweede Kamer voor alcoholmeter bij veroordeelden

en.title: Second Chamber supports alcohol monitor for convicted offenders
en.summary: A parliamentary majority backs introducing an alcohol monitoring ankle bracelet for people convicted of crimes involving alcohol who have received alcohol bans from courts. The device detects alcohol in sweat and skin moisture, alerting probation services to violations.

stories.title: Kamer zet sein op groen voor alcoholmeter: permanente controle via enkelband

en.title: Chamber gives green light for alcohol monitor: permanent surveillance via ankle bracelet
en.summary: Parliament has approved the introduction of alcohol monitoring ankle bracelets for ongoing supervision of convicted offenders subject to alcohol restrictions.

stories.title: Mogelijk voor het eerst planeet ontdekt die uit dode ster is ontstaan

en.title: Possibly first planet discovered formed from dead star
en.summary: Scientists have identified what may be the first planet created from material originating from a dead star, potentially representing a newly discovered class of planets.

stories.title: Tien gewonden bij steekpartij op school in Polen, verdachte (19) gearresteerd

en.title: Ten wounded in stabbing attack at school in Poland, suspect aged 19 arrested
en.summary: A 19-year-old student stabbed ten people at a vocational school in northern Poland, including five students, two teachers, and two bystanders. The suspect was arrested nearby and no victims are in life-threatening condition.

stories.title: Wilde zwijnen zorgen voor ravage op Limburgse begraafplaats

en.title: Wild boars cause damage at Limburgian cemetery
en.summary: Wild boars breached a cemetery in Schinnen, Limburg last month and disturbed multiple graves by rooting through the ground. Authorities are working on a solution to prevent further damage.

stories.title: Australische bisschop misbruikte jonge Aboriginals op drankovergoten feesten

en.title: Australian bishop abused young Aboriginals at alcohol-fueled gatherings
en.summary: Bishop Christopher Saunders abused members of isolated Aboriginal communities in his West Australian diocese over many years. Victims remained silent for years due to fear and distrust of authorities.

stories.title: Festival in Israël werd leeggeroofd na bloedige Hamas-aanval: man jaren de cel in

en.title: Man sentenced to seven years for looting Israeli festival after Hamas attack
en.summary: An Israeli court sentenced a man to seven years imprisonment for stealing sound equipment worth nearly half a million euros from a music festival site days after the October 7, 2023 Hamas attack that killed hundreds.

stories.title: Argentinië neemt afscheid van Lionel Messi, die er na vier verloren finales toch in slaagde in de voetsporen van Maradona te treden

en.title: Argentina bids farewell to Lionel Messi, who achieved Maradona's legacy after four lost finals
en.summary: Lionel Messi played his final match for Argentina. Argentine supporters, many overwhelmed with emotion, said goodbye to the footballer who brought them both sorrow and joy over decades.

stories.title: Israël herdenkt terreur 7 oktober, ook in Nederland bijeenkomsten

en.title: Israel commemorates October 7 terror attacks, gatherings also held in Netherlands
en.summary: Israel held commemorations today marking the third anniversary of the October 7, 2023 Hamas attacks, with ceremonies beginning at 06:29 local time. Multiple cities and towns across Israel and the Netherlands organized gatherings, and national moments of silence were observed.

stories.title: Wilde zwijnen ploegen begraafplaats om in Schinnen: 'Dit is heel pijnlijk'

en.title: Wild boars plow up cemetery in Schinnen: 'This is very painful'
en.summary: Wild boars disturbed multiple graves at a cemetery in Schinnen by rooting up the ground, including a grave of a woman buried there three weeks prior. The cemetery has fencing around the grass section, but it has not prevented the animals from causing damage.

stories.title: Geroofde vaas terug naar Sicilië: 'Afscheid pijnlijk, maar dient hoger doel'

en.title: Stolen vase returned to Sicily: 'Parting is painful, but serves a higher purpose'
en.summary: The Allard Pierson Museum in Amsterdam voluntarily returned an illegally excavated ancient vase to Sicily after nearly three decades in its collection. The Centuripe pyxis, a third-century BCE decorated vessel, was handed over to an Italian delegation.

stories.title: Allard Pierson Museum geeft antieke vaas terug aan Sicilië

en.title: Allard Pierson Museum returns ancient vase to Sicily
en.summary: The Allard Pierson Museum in Amsterdam returned an ancient vase to Sicily.
